open_points.subject: execute_function descriptor transport
open_points.text: Every descriptor the environment needs from the parent — the write end of the runner's channel, the --info-fd pipe — MUST reach bubblewrap by inheritance, passed with subprocess pass_fds, and keeps the number it has in the parent: the module never renumbers a descriptor (no os.dup2, no preexec_fn), --info-fd names the pipe's own number, and the runner learns the channel's number from runner_arguments.
open_points.other_text: bubblewrap has no option naming a descriptor to keep.
open_points.question: How can the runner inherit the channel descriptor through bubblewrap if the module may not renumber it and may use no bubblewrap option that preserves or names it?
